name: dataStoreCompromiseCount
definition: The number of data stores NodeZero accessed, summed across the ops the ops page returns; 0 only when at least one op reports an integer data_stores_count and every one reports 0.
population: Every op returned by the ops page for one NodeZero tenant (the query's window, not verified here); the value is the sum of each op's integer data_stores_count. Ops that do not report the field are left out.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: For 0: at least one op reports an integer data_stores_count, and all that report it report 0. No op, or no op carrying the field, is not 0.

changeLog.change: Registered so the Horizon3 NodeZero transforms can emit it; the meaning is what the transform reads, stated precisely. Unverified fields are named in notes.

notes: Only the NodeZero transform emits this key today. Field names are as that transform reads them; they were not live-verified against a NodeZero tenant, so the key stays proposed at V0 with the owner not yet named. The value sums across ops, so the same data store reached in two ops counts twice.
